newsitem.title: USA: Canada spot propane prices rise on U.S. strength.
newsitem.headline: Canada spot propane prices rise on U.S. strength.

text.p: Canada propane prices rose sharply this week tracking far stronger levels in the U.S. trading hub of Conway, Kansas, players said.
In the western Canadian hub of Edmonton, spot propane prices were assessed at between 80.0 and 90.0 cents a gallon on Thursday, up from about 76.00 cents late last week.
"Conway is the biggest influence," one Canada trader said, noting prices in the Midwest hub had jumped about eight cents a gallon since last week to 98.00 cents at midday Thursday.
"But not much (Edmonton) material is moving because buyers and sellers are pretty far apart," the trader added.

New U.S. Energy Information Administration data released Wednesday, moreover, showed a million-barrel draw on Midwest stocks for the prior week -- leaving the region's inventories well below normal for this time of year.
In the eastern Canadian hub of Sarnia, spot propane prices jumped about six cents a gallon since late last week to between 74.00 and 76.00 cents, players said, also helped by the Conway rally.
